title: Console: Retention Controls settings page (effective policy, legal hold banner, enforcement status)
author: Felix Schneider
description: Implements the Console UI for tenant-configurable retention controls (v1 scope) behind a feature flag. This adds a new Retention Controls page with (1) settings form for eligible datasets, (2) effective-policy panel that resolves precedence and shows guardrail clamping, (3) legal hold banner + read-only behavior when holds are active, and (4) enforcement status panel with last run timestamp, outcome, and recent errors/warnings. This PR is UI-only and depends on the control-plane/console backend endpoints introduced in PR #18510 (GET/PUT retention policy, GET effective policy, GET enforcement status). The UI is designed to be export-friendly (single-page view, printable layout, copyable JSON) for enterprise security reviews and aligns with v1 product requirements from PM-482/DES-144. Behavior notes: page is gated by `console.retentionControls.enabled`; users require `org:settings:write` to edit policies and `org:settings:read` to view; when a legal hold exists, the page shows a banner and disables edits with a tooltip referencing the hold; validation errors from the API are surfaced inline (min/max retention, disallowed 'never delete'); effective policy panel shows both configured values and the resolved effective values; enforcement status panel polls on initial load only (no background polling) to avoid noisy traffic, with a manual refresh action; all write actions generate an Admin Activity audit event via backend (not in this PR). Testing: adds unit tests for field rendering and validation mapping, MSW mocks for endpoints, and a Playwright smoke test to verify read-only mode and last-run rendering. Follow-ups: add deep links from Audit Logs page to the retention controls page; add docs link to compliance reporting pack; finalize copy for Private deployments where some datasets are not eligible for configuration.
